claims.claim: Under conditional independence given a bounded measured scalar proxy Z and known response curves p_i(Z), the attainable full parallel fate laws are exactly the closed convex hull of the curve of product-Bernoulli laws.
assumptions: modules are conditionally independent given A
response curves are fixed and known

claims.claim: For first-order hazards, every fate probability is a finite signed sum of evaluations of one common Laplace transform L(t); L is completely monotone and L(0)=1.
claims.biological_validation: the single-step hazard model is not validated for the cited Bxb1 branch device

claims.claim: With known L_i-Lipschitz response curves and iid same-cell scalar-readout measurements, n >= (Zmax*sum_i L_i)^2*log(2/delta)/(2*epsilon^2) measurements suffice to approximate the complete fate law within TV epsilon with confidence 1-delta.
assumptions: measurement noise is part of the readout or calibrated
claims.operational_gate: activity sensor, response-curve assays, and sensor calibration are unvalidated and separately costed

claims.claim: If all response curves are nondecreasing functions of the same measured scalar Z, shared-readout conditional-independent parallel fate bits have nonnegative pairwise covariance; therefore an equal one-hot target over m=10 states with pairwise joint probability zero is unreachable.

A categorical target over K positive-probability fates can be compiled to a binary tree with K-1 branch nodes and exact target path probabilities if every node resolves and calibrated competing cause hazards share a common multiplicative activity waveform.
assumptions: cause hazards proportional to same node activity
eventual node reaction or explicit completion feedback
claims.prior_art: sequential Bxb1/TP901 branching already demonstrated in An et al. 2026; no novelty claim

claims.claim: A constructed two-point activity distribution with 10 modules can make the independent product prediction of the all-on fate 1e9-fold too small.
claims.falsifier: measure per-cell active exposure and conditional response, then compare held-out 10-bit genotype law

claims.claim: Published Fig. 3 processed replicate-level means differ descriptively from the product of single-device marginal means by TV 0.03298 for two devices and 0.04731 for three devices.
limitations: does not identify shared-exposure heterogeneity or conditional dependence

claims.claim: Bxb1 product inhibition can cause module interactions by enzyme sequestration on residual DNA sites.
claims.source: Zhang et al. 2022, Nature Communications 13:4152, DOI 10.1038/s41467-022-31538-3
claims.implication: total Bxb1 abundance is not an accepted sufficient exposure without free-activity calibration and conditional-dependence tests

claims.claim: This branch establishes a newly validated biological capability or experimental design advantage over published sequential branching.
claims.reason: high-cardinality tree, activity sensing, conditional competing-hazard invariance in cellular constructs, and growth-corrected outputs remain unvalidated; sequential branching is prior art
